const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " // HN: 取 top stories 详情，筛出赚钱相关",
 " const r=await get('https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json');",
 " const ids=JSON.parse(r.body).slice(0,120);",
 " console.log('HN top ids:', ids.length);",
 " const KW=[/revenue/i,/\\$\\d/i,/MRR/i,/profit/i,/side project/i,/side hustle/i,/made \\$/i,/income/i,/monetiz/i,/indie/i,/bootstrap/i,/launch/i,/acquisition/i,/sold for/i,/earn/i];",
 " const hits=[];",
 " for(const id of ids){",
 " try{",
 " const d=await get('https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/'+id+'.json');",
 " const j=JSON.parse(d.body);",
 " if(!j || !j.title) continue;",
 " if(KW.some(function(re){return re.test(j.title)})){",
 " hits.push({id:id,title:j.title,score:j.score,url:j.url||('https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id='+id),time:j.time});",
 " }",
 " }catch(e){}",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,60)});",
 " }",
 " hits.sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score});",
 " console.log('\\n=== HN 赚钱相关 ('+hits.length+') ===');",
 " for(const h of hits.slice(0,25)){ console.log(h.score+'pts | '+h.title+'\\n '+h.url); }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-hn.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-hn.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch Hacker News money-related stories", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 8000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // HN: 取 top stories 详情，筛出赚钱相关",
  "  const r=await get('https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json');",
  "  const ids=JSON.parse(r.body).slice(0,120);",

  "  const hits=[];",
  "  for(const id of ids){",
  "    try{",
  "      const d=await get('https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/'+id+'.json');",
  "      const j=JSON.parse(d.body);",
  "      if(!j || !j.title) continue;",
  "      if(KW.some(function(re){return re.test(j.title)})){",
  "        hits.push({id:id,title:j.title,score:j.score,url:j.url||('https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id='+id),time:j.time});",
  "      }",
  "    }catch(e){}",

  "  }",
  "  hits.sort(function(a,b){return b.score-a.score});",
  "  console.log('\\n=== HN 赚钱相关 ('+hits.length+') ===');",
  "  for(const h of hits.slice(0,25)){ console.log(h.score+'pts | '+h.title+'\\n        '+h.url); }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
